refined_prompt: Locate and document the existing owner module/function in the DARWN codebase, then plan improvements to remediation bottlenecks. Discovery phase: (1) Identify owner-related code in /prisma/schema.prisma (Ownership model), /server/api/ (ownership endpoints), and /composables/ (ownership hooks); (2) Analyze patch ce2e8dcd7954 for established patterns in this domain; (3) Document current implementation in OWNER_MODULE_DISCOVERY.md with file paths, function signatures, and data flow. Planning phase: (1) Design improvements to address three measured bottlenecks: (a) simultaneous remediation process handling (async efficiency), (b) remediation loop scope definition (clarity/boundaries), (c) orchestration loop validation overhead (minimize checks); (2) Propose owner module enhancements aligned with existing patterns from ce2e8dcd7954; (3) Define scope boundaries to avoid overlapping with pareto-2080 or other active improvements; (4) Create implementation roadmap with estimated effort (8 story points plan-class, strategy-risk). Output: OWNER_MODULE_DISCOVERY.md (1–2 pages discovery notes) + OWNER_MODULE_IMPROVEMENT_PLAN.md (detailed plan with rationale, file paths, pseudo-code sketches, test strategy). All proposals must respect coordination rule: reuse prior solutions, do not overwrite queued improvements, leave recovered work in queue until shipped. QA validation via strategy planner (google:gemini-2.5-flash) to confirm scope boundaries and alignment with active work.
resolutions: Task class: 'plan (need 8, risk strategy)' from orchestration pipeline contract is authoritative. Improvement request fragment 'hard (need 8, risk broad_change)' is superseded; prioritize contract.

Owner module scope: Spans three layers in DARWN (Nuxt 3 + Prisma): (1) Data model in /prisma/schema.prisma (Ownership entity, relationships to MedicalStaff and User), (2) API layer in /server/api/ownership/ or /server/api/[entity]/ownership (CRUD endpoints, ownership queries), (3) Composable layer in /composables/useOwnership.ts or similar (shared ownership logic, calculations). Discovery task: search codebase for 'Ownership', 'Owner', 'ownership' to locate exact files.

Patch ce2e8dcd7954 role: Template for patterns, not a direct implementation target. Analyze its approach to module organization, async handling, and validation layering; apply equivalent patterns to owner module improvements rather than copy-paste.

QA panel definition: Use contract specification: 'independent QA route: local:llama3.1 (qpd leader q=7.7 n=1); QA panel: local:llama3.2:3b, deepseek:deepseek-v4-flash'. Improvement request fragment ending with 'local:llama3.2:' is truncated; discard.

Operator feedback (three measured bottlenecks) → Design constraints: (1) Simultaneous remediation processes: owner module must support concurrent writes without lock contention; use optimistic locking or event-sourced updates. (2) Remediation loop scope: owner module enhancements must NOT affect pareto-2080 or active loop-generated work; scope explicitly in plan. (3) Orchestration validation overhead: minimize synchronous checks in owner module; defer non-critical validation to async post-processing.

Acceptance criteria: (A) Discovery completeness: all owner-related files located and mapped in OWNER_MODULE_DISCOVERY.md; (B) Plan clarity: improvement proposals are bounded in scope, include estimated effort, and acknowledge active work constraints; (C) Pattern alignment: proposed changes reference or adapt patterns from ce2e8dcd7954 (async handling, validation layering, scope boundaries); (D) Test strategy: plan includes 20+ test cases covering owner module interactions, remediation concurrency, and scope isolation; (E) No overwrites: coordination rule verified—proposed changes do not delete or overwrite queued improvements.

Merge/release workflow: Auto-merge OWNER_MODULE_DISCOVERY.md and OWNER_MODULE_IMPROVEMENT_PLAN.md to orchestrator/dev after strategy planner validation and test coverage review; gate production release via batch train (no direct main/master push). Rollback criterion: if actual bottleneck measurements diverge from operator feedback, pause merge and re-assess.
